name: plan-author

triggers: controller enters the plan stage with an accepted intake (approved spec digest, lease held)
a plan-invalidating drift exception has been approved and the plan must be re-derived
antiTriggers: no approved executable spec exists (spec drafting is not a lifecycle role)
the request is to write tests or code for a packet
the plan exists and only a packet's implementation is pending

outputs.name: packetDag
outputs.type: PacketPlan (spec §4.2: flat packets, disjoint allowedPaths, typed dependency reasons)

procedure: Read the executable spec; enumerate acceptance criteria and interfaces touched.
Map the dependency graph of seams from the repository as it is at baseSha.
Slice vertically: each packet is an end-to-end, demoable increment with a tracer-bullet blocking edge to its prerequisites.
Assign disjoint allowedPaths and a typed dependency reason per edge; record parent_intent per packet.
Verify every criterion maps to at least one packet; emit the flat DAG and its digest.
completion: plan.dag-schema-valid, plan.total-criterion-coverage and plan.classifier-rule-valid predicates pass
no packet mutates another packet's paths
plan digest recorded in the run record
evidence: list of files read while deriving the graph

failure.handoff: Return findings to the controller; a spec gap or scope conflict becomes an owner decision request (owner.scope-or-waiver-exception-if-required). The role never edits the spec.

adopted: dependency graph before slicing; high-risk first (Addy)
parent_intent, public outputs, typed dependency reasons (recursive-development, pattern only)
rejected: tasks/plan.md and tasks/todo.md checklist files or external tracker writes (plan is an immutable digest, not mutable state)
ticket creation in an issue tracker
runtime dependencies and automatic recursive decomposition
plan mode as an agent-specific tool
